headings.title: Short title as Missouri Rice Certification Act
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 2007 H.B. 741, A.L. 2010 H.B. 1840). Names the section the 'Missouri Rice Certification Act'.

headings.title: Section definitions and wild rice exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 including subdivisions (1)–(9) and history note. Defines section-scoped terms including characteristics of commercial impact (referencing subsection 7), council, department, director, end user, handler, person, producer, and rice (excluding wild rice; retains archived spelling 'Zinzania aquatic or Zinzania palustris').

headings.title: Restrictions on handling commercial-impact rice
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Makes it unlawful to introduce, sell, plant, produce, harvest, transport, store, process, or otherwise handle rice identified as having characteristics of commercial impact, qualified by 'Except as provided by rules promulgated by the department'.

headings.title: Rice Advisory Council creation and ten-member composition
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 including subdivisions (1)–(3) and paragraphs (a)–(d) and history note. Creates the Rice Advisory Council within the department of agriculture and specifies its ten members, appointment authorities, and Missouri Rice Research and Merchandising Council recommendations.

headings.title: Council member terms, staggering, unlimited reappointment, and vacancies
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Covers three-year terms, permanent director membership, initial two-, three-, and four-year staggered terms, absence of term limits, and filling vacancies in the same representational manner.

headings.title: Council meetings, annual chair election, and expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6 and history note. Covers at least twice-annual meetings called by the annually elected chairperson, unpaid service, and reimbursement of actual and necessary expenses.

headings.title: Powers and duties of Rice Advisory Council
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 7 including subdivisions (1)–(4) and history note. Covers identifying commercial-impact rice varieties, reviewing identity-preservation program terms, reviewing identified varieties at least every two years or on purveyor petition, and making recommendations to the director.

headings.title: Department powers over rice integrity, notifications, and enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 8 including subdivisions (1)–(6) and history note. Covers protecting non-commercial-impact rice from contamination, weeds, diseases, and pests, requiring planting and processing notifications for in-state and out-of-state commercial-impact rice, enforcing handling restrictions, and investigating violations, issuing notices, providing appeals, and imposing penalties.

headings.title: Sampling and testing fees reviewed by council
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 9 and history note. Covers permissive authority of the department to establish and collect reasonable fees for necessary rice sampling and testing, subject to review by the rice advisory council.

headings.title: Rulemaking under chapter 536 and nonseverability condition
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 10 and history note. Covers mandatory rulemaking, effectiveness conditioned on compliance with chapter 536 and section 536.028 (referencing section 536.010), and the nonseverability clause voiding rulemaking authority and rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2007, if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

headings.title: Department reporting of potential commercial-impact varieties
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 11 and history note. Requires the department to regularly report to the rice advisory council any findings of rice varieties that could potentially have characteristics of commercial impact.

headings.title: Adverse-effect recommendations, public hearing, and department opinion
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 12 and history note. Covers permissive council recommendations when commercial-impact rice is documented as causing unreasonable adverse environmental or public health effects, triggering a department public hearing within 60 days and a detailed response opinion within 30 days after the hearing.

headings.title: Daily per-violation monetary penalty range
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 13 and history note. Sets the penalty for violating a provision of this section at $10,000 to $100,000 per day per violation without adding unstated civil/criminal characterization (read alongside department penalty-imposition authority in subsection 8(6)).

headings.title: Written violation notice, appeal notice, and judicial relief
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 14 and history note. Requires written notice upon a department violation determination informing the person of the right to request an appeal, and preserves the right to seek judicial relief in a court of competent jurisdiction.

headings.title: Missouri Rice Certification Fund creation, nonreversion, and investment
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 15 including subdivisions (1)–(3) and history note. Covers fund creation from section fees, department administration, state treasurer custody and disbursements under sections 30.170 and 30.180, biennial nonreversion notwithstanding section 33.080, and treasurer investment with credited interest.

headings.title: Exemption from sections 610.010 to 610.200
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 16 and history note. Preserves the exact cross-reference exempting provisions of this section from sections 610.010 to 610.200.
